title: Certified Computer Operator | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: Certified Computer Operator. Category: Development. Duration: 3 months. Description: MS Office basics for word processing, data management, presentations, and email organization. This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city. (Source: SMIT official AI data feed, saylanimit.com/llms-full.txt)
